what: Measurements that did not exist when the first draft was written, made on the first-draft script (speeds-kit ca80695) by the current checks/measure_sample_predictors.py, so that the registration can give them a first-draft value. Large bank, the same invented sample (seed 2). Only the keys the first-draft measured files lack are kept; checked_against_the_baseline says how many of the keys it has were measured again and found the same.
command: python3 checks/measure_sample_predictors.py <the ca80695 script> MOCK_URL --bank large

checked_against_the_baseline.not_compared: timings (feedback_ms, loading, the seconds a message stays on screen)
